header: The supply terms in plain language
intro: The short version of our terms of sale and delivery, written so a buyer can check the points that usually decide a purchase order before the legal review starts. The full document is what binds; this page is a reading aid.

items.title: How long a price holds
items.summary: Quoted prices stand for 30 days. Alloy surcharges are passed through at the rate on the day the material is ordered and shown as a separate line on the invoice.

items.title: When a delivery counts as accepted
items.summary: A delivery is accepted if no complaint reaches Graz within ten working days of goods-in, or as soon as the parts have been installed, whichever comes first.

items.title: Tooling and the drawings you send us
items.summary: Tooling invoiced to you stays in our plants so we can maintain it, and title passes on final payment. Drawings you supply are used for your orders only and are never shown to another customer.
